definitions.gloss: to butt in; to interrupt; to interject
definitions.explanation: To insert a comment or opinion into someone else's conversation or discussion, often uninvited. Literally 'to insert one's mouth.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口|くち}を{挟|はさ}んできた。
⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{口|くち}を{挟|はさ}む⟦{余地|よち}→余地：07612_yochi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: During the meeting, there was no room for the boss to interject.

notes:
USAGE: {口|くち}を{挟|はさ}む usually carries a slightly negative nuance, suggesting the interruption was unwelcome or unsolicited. However, it can also be neutral depending on context.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [topic]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口|くち}を{挟|はさ}む (to butt into [a topic/conversation])

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口|くち}を{挟|はさ}む: to interrupt a conversation
- {口|くち}を{挟|はさ}む⟦{余地|よち}→余地：07612_yochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no room to get a word in
- ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{口|くち}を{挟|はさ}む: to butt in from the side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口出|くちだ}しする→口出しする：25233_kuchidashisuru⟧: to meddle, to interfere (stronger negative nuance)
- ⟦{割|わ}り{込|こ}む→割り込む：06973_warikomu⟧: to cut in, to interrupt (more physical sense)
